transcript.text: I need to put my quality requirements on the record. My completed lab review shows the reclaimed polymer is suitable for this housing only at a 15% reclaimed-to-85% virgin blend. Additionally, I confirmed that the first 50 molded housings must receive FTIR identity testing. However, the lab result has not yet been attached to the production traveler, and I will ensure that is completed before the scheduled run on Thursday.

transcript.text: Here are my environmental-compliance requirements, on the record. My review of the supplier's revised safety data sheet—received late yesterday and not yet entered in the plant's chemical register—classifies the reclaimed lot's additive residue as regulated process waste. That means we need labeled segregated storage and a hazardous-waste manifest for any discarded pellets or purge material. I can complete the chemical-register entry, storage setup, and manifest procedures before Thursday, and I will provide environmental-compliance sign-off once those controls are complete.

commitments.detail: Lab result must be attached to the production traveler before the Thursday run.
First 50 molded housings must receive FTIR identity testing.
Supplier's revised safety data sheet must be entered in the plant's chemical register before Thursday.
Labeled segregated storage must be set up for the reclaimed lot and any discarded pellets or purge material.
Hazardous-waste manifest procedures must be completed for any discarded pellets or purge material.
Environmental-compliance sign-off must be provided once storage, manifest, and chemical-register controls are complete.
Record material approval for the reclaimed lot at 15% blend for the medical-device housing run.
